new_jobs.title: Manager, Global Infrastructure Supply Chain & Engineering
new_jobs.jd: Meta is seeking an experienced sourcing and commodity management leader to oversee the infrastructure supply chain supporting Meta's global data center and hardware supply chain. In this role, you will lead a team of supply chain professionals responsible for managing supplier relationships and supply chain execution to the contracts. You will be developing execution strategies, and mechanisms for commodity management across server, storage, networking, and other infrastructure hardware categories. You will partner closely with sourcing, hardware engineering, supply chain, finance, and operations teams to ensure supply continuity, cost competitiveness, and strategic alignment across Meta's infrastructure build programs. Manager, Global Infrastructure Supply Chain & Engineering Responsibilities: * Lead and develop a team of Supply Chain Managers responsible for infrastructure OEM hardware delivery, including servers, storage, networking, and custom silicon components * Define and execute multi-year execution strategies and mechanisms that align with Meta's infrastructure capacity planning and data center build roadmaps * Oversee suppliers' performance management for commodities, OEM and ODM partners across the infrastructure hardware supply chain * Partner with hardware engineering and product teams to influence supplier roadmaps and ensure early engagement on new infrastructure platform development * Establish and monitor supplier scorecards, KPIs, and risk mitigation frameworks to ensure supply continuity and quality across critical infrastructure programs * Collaborate with finance and capacity planning teams to develop the total cost of ownership models and deliver cost reduction targets across managed commodity categories * Build organizational capability by defining team structure, hiring, and developing sourcing talent to support a growing infrastructure procurement scope * Provide executive-level reporting and recommendations on supply risk, market dynamics, and commodity cost trends affecting infrastructure operations * Drive process improvements and sourcing best practices across the team to increase efficiency, reduce cycle time, and improve supplier accountability Minimum Qualifications: * 10+ years of experience in technical sourcing, commodity management, or supply chain management within the infrastructure hardware, data center, or consumer electronics industry * 6+ years of experience in managing and developing sourcing or supply chain teams, including setting team direction and managing performance * Experience developing and executing commodity strategies across multiple hardware categories in a high-volume, fast-paced infrastructure environment * Experience partnering with hardware engineering, operations, and finance stakeholders to align the sourcing strategy with the product and capacity roadmaps Preferred Qualifications: * Experience managing supplier relationships for custom or co-designed infrastructure hardware, including engagement with ODMs on new platform development * Track record of delivering measurable cost savings and supply chain improvements at organizational scale through cross-functional collaboration * Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) * Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) * Experience building supplier management frameworks and leading supply chain continuity programs across a global supplier base * Familiarity with data center infrastructure architecture and the technical requirements that drive OEM hardware specifications and supplier selection * Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies About Meta: Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics. Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

new_jobs.title: Factory Production Planner LMT
new_jobs.jd: **The group you’ll be a part of** Global Order Fulfillment - Global Operations The Systems Planning organization within Global Order Fulfillment is at the center of Lam’s ability to deliver predictable, scalable, and responsive operations. By bringing together planning, manufacturing, supply chain, and logistics, Systems Planning ensures that customer demand is translated into clear, executable outcomes across the global factory network. The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business. **The impact you’ll make** The Factory Production Planning (FPP) role is the single accountable owner of the factory production plan, responsible for balancing demand, capacity, and constraints to deliver an executable plan that supports on-time customer delivery and operational efficiency. FPP translates global production targets and demand signals into realistic factory plans by aligning manufacturing capacity, resource availability, and business priorities. Acting as the critical link between strategic planning and factory execution, FPP ensures plans are feasible, stable, and achievable while providing clear visibility to risks, constraints, and mitigation actions. Working closely with Global Production Planning (GPP), Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Logistics, FPP drives informed trade-off decisions across capacity, volume, product mix, and factory loading to optimize network performance and support customer commitments. The role governs production planning assumptions, maintains plan integrity, and ensures transparent communication of plan changes, risks, and impacts. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, business acumen, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders while enabling faster decision-making, improved schedule stability, and disciplined execution across the manufacturing network. **What You’ll Do** In this role, you will directly influence Lam’s ability to deliver predictably at scale in a highly constrained and dynamic manufacturing environment. By owning and governing the integrated production and capacity plan, you will: * Enable predictable execution by providing a single, trusted plan of record that aligns demand, capacity, and constraints across the global network * Drive earlier, faster decision‑making by identifying structural risks upstream and leading clear trade‑off decisions before issues reach execution forums * Improve global capacity utilization and efficiency by planning capacity as a shared enterprise asset rather than reacting to site‑level constraints * Protect customer delivery commitments by translating demand into feasible plans and mitigating risks before they impact lead time, SRD, or shipment performance * Strengthen planning governance and confidence by ensuring data integrity, transparent assumptions, and disciplined version‑to‑version plan management * Support Lam’s growth by enabling a scalable operating model capable of sustaining accelerated demand without increasing churn, late escalations, or execution instability **Who We’re Looking For** * Strategic thinker with strong business and financial acumen * Highly analytical and data‑driven, with exceptional attention to detail * Comfortable making and defending trade‑off decisions under ambiguity * Strong influencer with the ability to align diverse stakeholders globally * Resilient and adaptable in environments with frequent change and competing priorities * High accountability, ownership mindset, and commitment to quality and execution excellence * Continuous improvement mindset with a passion for building scalable, disciplined planning processes **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience) * Proven experience in production planning, manufacturing operations, or supply chain planning in a global environment * Strong understanding of S&OP, capacity planning, and production planning frameworks * Demonstrated ability to manage plans in highly constrained, fast‑changing environments * Experience with enterprise planning systems and data tools (e.g., SAP, CRM, Kinaxis, Power BI, Microsoft applications) * APICS / ASCM CPIM or CSCP certification preferred **Our commitment** We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results. Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees. *Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.*

new_jobs.title: Industry Manager, Export, Large Customer Sales
new_jobs.jd: Google welcomes people with disabilities. **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of industry experience in advertising, consultative sales, business development, or IT, or 6 years of experience with an advanced degree. * Ability to travel for client meetings and training, as needed. **Preferred qualifications:** * 8 years of experience in tech enterprise sales, business consultative, business development, advertising, or EC, or 6 years of experience with an advanced degree. * Experience in stakeholder management. * Experience in cross-functional project management. * Experience in developing relationships with executive-level stakeholders. * Understanding of cross-functional media businesses and operations. * Excellent problem-solving skills. **About The Job** As an Industry Manager, you will be an architect of strategic growth, forging trusted alliances with C-level stakeholders to align on ambitious business goals. You will harness the power of generative AI and predictive analytics to navigate profound industry shifts, winning with unique value and maximizing impact to prove the long-term success of our partners. In this role, you will work with customers to provide digital solutions for sales and marketing objectives via a variety of Google products and tools, finding and managing business customer relationships. Utilizing influencing and relationship-building skills, you will provide Google-caliber client service, research, and market analysis, anticipating how decisions are made, understanding the details of individual campaigns, and persistently exploring, and uncovering the business needs of key business lines. Alongside our customers, you will set the goal and strategy for how their advertising can reach users. Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google. **Responsibilities** * Maintain strong relationships with clients, agencies, and other key stakeholders to ensure alignment with business objectives and successful collaboration. * Lead the execution of strategies to drive adoption, business, and strategy for Google ads solution - leveraging digital marketing tools and platforms to optimize client advertising efforts. * Analyze and optimize marketing Return on Investment (ROI) by monitoring and assessing the performance of digital campaigns for YouTube, making data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement. * Oversee and coordinate with agency partners, ensuring effective communication, collaboration, and utilization of resources to drive successful marketing initiatives. * Be on top of industry trends and innovations in digital marketing, providing insights and recommendations to keep the team and clients at the forefront of the evolving marketing landscape. new_jobs.title: Staff Research Scientist, Android Pixel Audio
new_jobs.location: Banqiao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
new_jobs.jd: For Taiwan applicants: Google welcomes people with disabilities. For Australia applicants: At Google, we have a vision of empowerment and equitable opportunity for all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and commit to building reconciliation through Google’s technology, platforms and people and we welcome Indigenous applicants. Please see our Reconciliation Action Plan for more information. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New Taipei, Banqiao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan; Sydney NSW, Australia** . **Minimum qualifications:** * PhD degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 4 years of experience with research agendas across multiple teams or projects. * One of more scientific publication submission(s) for conferences, journals, or public repositories (such as CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.). **Preferred qualifications:** * 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 3 year of experience with an advanced degree. * Experience with machine learning principles and model architectures. * Experience in audio and speech related model development and inference. * Multiple scientific publications at audio/signal processing/speech/ML research conferences, journals, or public repositories. **About the job** As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. As a Staff Research Scientist in Android Pixel Audio, you will be responsible for algorithm development for audio use cases across Pixel product lines. You will innovate, execute and validate audio pipelines through both offline simulation and real-time on-device hardware. You will be interacting with partner teams such as DeepMind and Google Silicon teams to design and modify the algorithms and software layers to impact the upcoming Google audio technology roadmap across the Pixel ecosystem.The Google Pixel team focuses on designing and delivering the world's most helpful mobile experience. The team works on shaping the future of Pixel devices and services through some of the most advanced designs, techniques, products, and experiences in consumer electronics. This includes bringing together the best of Google’s artificial intelligence, software, and hardware to build global smartphones and create transformative experiences for users across the world. **Responsibilities** * Own machine learning model development including model training and optimization. * Contribute to model inference optimization into Android Kernel/HAL and audio and speech algorithms development process. * Design and fine tune Machine Learning (ML) models for Pixel devices. * Contribute to prototyping to delivery for audio features. * Collaborate with Android Pixel Audio and Google Silicon teams for feature development. new_jobs.jd: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Google welcomes people with disabilities. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Zhubei, Zhubei City, Hsinchu County, Taiwan; New Taipei, Banqiao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan** . **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * 2 years of experience programming in C/C++, Python. * Experience in image and signal processing. **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering. * 5 years of experience in image and signal processing on chip products. * Experience in SoC development environment. * Experience in reference model development. * Knowledge of image, video, and computer vision processing algorithms. * Proficiency in C, C++, or Python programming. **About the job** Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration. In this role, you will help develop C-model architecture for Image Signal Processor (ISP). You'll create and maintain a software environment for reference ISP C-models, and develop a system model that expands the team to work across organizations for ISP integration. You will work with ISP architects, implementation designers, verification engineers, and software engineers, providing bit-accurate system c-models and specifications. Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. We aim to make people's lives better through technology. **Responsibilities** * Create and maintain software architecture for next generation ISP system. * Implement, model, analyze, and test ISP algorithm pipeline. * Develop a software environment for ISP system development and simulation. * Support delivery of ISP C-models for implementation, verification, and SoC system. * Integrate the ISP C-models into a tuning and pre-silicon software environment. new_jobs.title: System and Industrial Engineer
new_jobs.location: Linkou District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
new_jobs.jd: **Who We Are** Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. **What We Offer** Location: Linkou,TWN You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. Position Summary Applied Materials is seeking a motivated and analytical new graduate to support logistics operations through data analysis, process improvement, and logistics systems coordination. This role provides hands-on exposure to Industrial Engineering, warehouse operations, logistics technologies, business analytics, and digital transformation initiatives. The successful candidate will work with regional operations teams, IT partners, and logistics service providers to support operational excellence, systems enhancement projects, process automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. Key Responsibilities Industrial Engineering & Analytics * Support warehouse capacity planning, productivity analysis, labor planning, and storage optimization projects. * Collect and analyze operational data to identify trends, improvement opportunities, and business insights. * Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytical tools using Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools. * Assist with warehouse layout studies, process improvement initiatives, and operational assessments. * Support the standardization of Industrial Engineering methodologies, productivity metrics, and planning tools. Logistics Systems & Digital Solutions * Support enhancement requests and business requirements related to logistics and supply chain systems. * Coordinate with Operations, IT, and business stakeholders to support system improvement projects and issue resolution. * Track development requests, testing activities, project milestones, and implementation progress using project management tools. * Support user acceptance testing (UAT), process documentation, and user training activities. * Assist in identifying opportunities for process automation, workflow optimization, and digital transformation initiatives. * Act as a logistics systems super user, supporting business users across various logistics platforms and tools. Data Automation & Business Intelligence * Support the development of dashboards, reports, and data visualization solutions to improve operational visibility. * Assist in automating repetitive processes using low-code/no-code tools, scripting, or workflow automation platforms. * Participate in data integration, data quality improvement, and analytics initiatives. * Support business intelligence projects that enable data-driven decision making. Cross-Functional Collaboration * Work closely with Operations, Transportation, Planning, IT, and Supply Chain teams on improvement projects. * Support regional and global initiatives related to operational excellence, logistics technology, and process standardization. * Collaborate with stakeholders to gather business requirements and translate them into practical system or process solutions. **Qualifications** Required * Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis. * Strong communication and organizational skills. * Ability to work effectively in a team environment. * Interest in logistics systems, business applications, and digital technologies. **Preferred** * Internship or project experience related to logistics, supply chain, operations, analytics, information systems, or process improvement. * Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, RPA tools, Power Automate, or similar analytics and automation technologies. * Exposure to enterprise business systems such as ERP, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), or similar platforms. * Basic understanding of process automation, data visualization, and digital transformation concepts. * Interest in becoming a systems super user and driving technology-enabled business improvements. Why Join Us * Exposure to global logistics and supply chain operations. * Opportunity to work on Industrial Engineering, analytics, automation, and logistics systems projects. * Hands-on experience collaborating with Operations, IT, and regional stakeholders on business improvement initiatives. * Strong learning and development opportunities in data analytics, process automation, digital solutions, and logistics technology. * Develop valuable super-user capabilities in enterprise systems and business applications that support global logistics operations. A confident, data-driven Industrial Engineering professional who combines strong analytical capability with business acumen and influencing skills. The individual must be able to translate complex operational data into actionable recommendations, challenge assumptions through fact-based analysis, and build alignment across Operations, Planning, Network Operations, IT, and regional stakeholders. Success in this role requires strategic thinking, strong ownership, effective communication, and the ability to drive change without direct authority. **Additional Information** **Time Type:** Full time **Employee Type:** New College Grad **Travel:** Yes, 10% of the Time **Relocation Eligible:** Yes Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
